source.title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Maksumäärad ja maksuvaba tulu suurus, 2026 (last updated 26.03.2026); Maksumuudatused 2026. aastal (27.11.2025)

sections.basis: Taxable income of a resident individual, per year
sections.note: One flat rate on the income of resident individuals. The basic exemption (€700 a month, €8,400 a year) is deducted first; from 2026 it no longer falls as income rises. Employers withhold 22% from pay. The planned 2% security tax was not introduced.

sections.note: Employees pay no social tax: the 33% social tax is the employer's. Income tax (22%) is withheld from pay after the basic exemption.

rows.value: Taxed at the employer: income tax 22/78 of the benefit plus 33% social tax

rows.value: A lower treaty rate or exemption applies when the recipient's certificate of residency is on file with the Tax and Customs Board

sections.note: Tax residency: a permanent home in Estonia or at least 183 days in 12 consecutive months (see the freelancer section). Social tax and unemployment insurance follow the EU coordination rules or social-security agreements (an A1 certificate keeps the home country's insurance).

rows.value: Work under another person's management and control for pay is employment; paid work is presumed to be employment unless the worker is substantially free to choose how, when and where to work
